set.request: the framework/styles/layouts/space/ page needs a better layout. the 5 layouts aren't all visible at once, and they should be, make them fit in a single row, so we can see all 5 on screen at once. move the controls above. make a note about the layout text syntax. can you make a control for complexity? or level of detail? can you make a doc tab that shows a full list of possible layout words, and what they look like? maybe add any important/useful layouts that are missing?
steps: Scope: read the page, the ruler, the generator, the word vocabulary
Rebuild the lab - controls above, ruler as one non-wrapping row of five
Complexity control: gen(seed, detail), wired to a slider
Presets: add the important shapes that are missing
Words tab: every layout word, live, at space/words/
Syntax note: doc/syntax.md, notes: on the Doc
set.outcome:
**The ruler is one row at one scale** — /framework/styles/layouts/space/ · [Words](/framework/styles/layouts/space/words/) · [Syntax](/framework/styles/layouts/space/docs/syntax/)

Controls moved above (textarea, seed stepper, detail dial, nine presets); the five screens now sit in a single non-wrapping row at ONE zoom, so a card 200px wide on the 1280 screen is 200px wide on the 3440 one. Per-shot fitting was the bug behind "they are not all visible at once".

New: a **detail dial** (gen(seed, detail), five steps, each a guarantee rather than a cap); **nine presets** where there were four, every name a real directory in the rail (document, shell, split, dashboard, masonry added; wall renamed gallery); a **Words** tab — 35 cards, every word the format accepts with a live picture drawn from a spec; and a **Syntax** note holding the grammar.
